uncited: **Identify Desired Region:** Compute the set of all chunk positions within the render distance from the camera.
**Identify Existing Region:** Extract the set of positions currently held in the `chunks` hash map.
For each position $p \in \_chunksAlreadyExist$, if $p \notin \_nearbyPositionsSet$, the chunk is no longer needed.
For each position $p \in \_nearbyPositionsSet$, if $p \notin \_chunksAlreadyExist$, the chunk is missing.
